hits.title: Previewing GPT-5.6 Sol: a next-generation model
hits.body: OpenAI previews GPT-5.6 Sol, a next-generation model with stronger capabilities in coding, science, and cybersecurity, paired with its most advanced safety stack.
hits.reason: OpenAI's new model announcement requires review of the OpenAI-to-Bedrock migration guide to assess whether GPT-5.6 Sol changes the competitive positioning, pricing, or model mapping recommendations for migrations from OpenAI to AWS Bedrock.

hits.title: OpenAI models, Codex, and Managed Agents come to AWS
hits.body: OpenAI GPT models, Codex, and Managed Agents are now available on AWS, enabling enterprises to build secure AI in their AWS environments.
hits.reason: OpenAI models now available directly on AWS changes the competitive landscape and availability facts that these files use to guide migration decisions away from OpenAI.

hits.title: Introducing GPT-5.4 mini and nano
hits.body: GPT-5.4 mini and nano are smaller, faster versions of GPT-5.4 optimized for coding, tool use, multimodal reasoning, and high-volume API and sub-agent workloads.
hits.reason: New OpenAI models (GPT-5.4 mini and nano) require updating the model mapping table and competitive pricing analysis in the OpenAI-to-Bedrock migration guide.
